reasons: The cited grant clauses meet the preferred position: 13.1 extends the subscription licence to Customer's Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf without a notice condition; 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up/embedded software to Customer and its Affiliates with contractor support rights.

13.3 permits no at-will revocation — suspension/revocation is limited to material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity — and licence rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor via the Section 24.1 permitted-assignment right covering M&A and asset sales without Vendor consent.

No walk-away features (revocable at Vendor's discretion, affiliates/contractors excluded, 'internal use only' with no path) appear; deterministic checks for affiliate coverage and absence of at-will revocation both pass.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed, which is correct here; the only inaccuracy is a passing reference to Section 24.4 not included in the cited paragraphs, which does not affect the classification.
